body: The office will remain closed from 27 May to 31 May 2026 for Eid-ul-Adha. Regular work resumes on 1 June 2026.
title: Office closed for Eid-ul-Adha

body: October 2026 salaries will be disbursed to bank accounts on 28 October 2026. Payslips are available from the Payroll menu.
title: October salary disbursement
